answer: The orchard trades an identity only when Q distinct yarrows sign its epoch, one signature per yarrow per epoch. Each yarrow locks relic on what it signs: its n-th lifetime signature posts n×base relic, forfeit whole to whoever proves that identity fake. The count sits on the yarrow, not the buyer, so k clones each epoch exhaust the low-notch yarrows: by epoch E the cheapest signers carry near kE/N notches and demand matching bribes, so the k-th clone's bill climbs with k, unparallelizable since no yarrow signs twice per epoch. The sole door left is bribing N unrelated strangers.
